# Leaflet 1.9.4

`leaflet.js`, `leaflet.css` and `LICENSE` (BSD-2-Clause) are the unchanged files of the npm package `leaflet@1.9.4` (`dist/leaflet.js`, `dist/leaflet.css`, `LICENSE`), whose tarball has the npm integrity `sha512-nxS1ynzJOmOlHp+iL3FyWqK89GtNL8U8rvlMOsQdTTssxZwCXh8N2NB3GDQOL+YR3XnWyZAxwQixURb+FA74PA==`. Their SHA-256:

| File | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `leaflet.js` | `db49d009c841f5ca34a888c96511ae936fd9f5533e90d8b2c4d57596f4e5641a` |
| `leaflet.css` | `a7837102824184820dfa198d1ebcd109ff6d0ff9a2672a074b9a1b4d147d04c6` |
| `LICENSE` | `53e8dc25862014e4324741ca18fbe3611e11d42ef69f59f86ea8c5389647d4cb` |

Only builds with app extensions embed them (`extras/src/lib.rs`). The images that `leaflet.css` names are not included: the pages use no Leaflet image markers or layer control.
